name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds (Linux + RSDWServerAPI)
author: cobratrinity@proton.me
description: RuneScape: Dragonwilds dedicated server (Steam app 4019830, native Linux build) with the RSDWServerAPI mod preloaded: REST API, Source RCON, in-game /kick /ban /unban /give, broadcasts and a Discord chat/death relay. The game port is the primary allocation (UDP). Assign extra allocations for the REST and RCON ports and enter them in the variables. Note: this is the Linux build, so UE4SS mods (Windows build only) are not supported.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# RuneScape: Dragonwilds (Linux) + RSDWServerAPI - install script for the Pterodactyl/Pelican egg.
# Runs in ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian with the server's files mounted at /mnt/server.

SERVER_DIR=/mnt/server
APPID="${SRCDS_APPID:-4019830}"

need_tools() {
    for tool in curl jq unzip tar; do
        command -v "${tool}" >/dev/null 2>&1 && continue
        apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends \
            curl jq unzip tar ca-certificates >/dev/null
        return
    done
}

install_game() {
    echo "[install] SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/steamcmd" "${SERVER_DIR}/steamapps"
    curl -fsSL -o /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz \
        https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || return 1
    tar -xzf /tmp/steamcmd.tar.gz -C "${SERVER_DIR}/steamcmd" || return 1

    export HOME="${SERVER_DIR}"
    cd "${SERVER_DIR}/steamcmd" || return 1

    # SteamCMD frequently exits non-zero on its first run while it self-updates.
    local tries=0
    until [ -x "${SERVER_DIR}/RSDragonwilds/Binaries/Linux/RSDragonwildsServer-Linux-Shipping" ]; do
        tries=$((tries + 1))
        [ "${tries}" -gt 3 ] && { echo "[install] SteamCMD failed after 3 attempts"; return 1; }
        echo "[install] Dragonwilds dedicated server, app ${APPID} (attempt ${tries})"
        ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir "${SERVER_DIR}" +login anonymous \
            +app_update "${APPID}" validate +quit
    done

    # Unreal's Steam subsystem looks for this in ~/.steam/sdk64 (HOME is /home/container).
    mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk64"
    cp -f linux64/steamclient.so "${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"
    chmod +x "${SERVER_DIR}/RSDragonwilds/Binaries/Linux/RSDragonwildsServer-Linux-Shipping"
}

# Picks the release asset by name, never by position. An earlier community installer took
# assets[0] and ended up running a different build than the one it reported (issue #5).
release_asset_url() {
    local repo="${RSDWAPI_REPO:-dkoz/RSDWServerAPI}"
    local release="${RSDWAPI_RELEASE:-latest}"
    local api="https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases"
    if [ "${release}" = "latest" ]; then api="${api}/latest"; else api="${api}/tags/${release}"; fi

    local json
    json=$(curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "${api}") || return 1
    echo "${json}" | jq -r '
        [ (.assets[] | select(.name == "librsdwapi.so")),
          (.assets[] | select(.name | test("\\.so$"))),
          (.assets[] | select(.name | test("(?i)linux.*\\.zip$"))),
          (.assets[] | select(.name | test("\\.zip$"))) ]
        | first | .browser_download_url // empty'
}

install_rsdwapi() {
    if [ "${RSDWAPI_ENABLED:-1}" != "1" ] && [ "${RSDWAPI_ENABLED:-}" != "true" ]; then
        echo "[install] RSDWServerAPI disabled, skipping"
        return 0
    fi

    local url="${RSDWAPI_URL:-}"
    if [ -z "${url}" ]; then
        url=$(release_asset_url)
        if [ -z "${url}" ]; then
            echo "[install] WARNING: no RSDWServerAPI release asset found in" \
                 "${RSDWAPI_REPO:-dkoz/RSDWServerAPI} (${RSDWAPI_RELEASE:-latest})."
            echo "[install]          Upload librsdwapi.so to the server root or set the Download URL."
            return 0
        fi
    fi

    echo "[install] RSDWServerAPI from ${url}"
    local work=/tmp/rsdwapi
    rm -rf "${work}" && mkdir -p "${work}"
    if ! curl -fsSL -o "${work}/download" "${url}"; then
        echo "[install] WARNING: download failed, the server will start without the API"
        return 0
    fi

    local so="${work}/download"
    if unzip -tq "${so}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        unzip -oq "${so}" -d "${work}/x"
        so=$(find "${work}/x" -type f -name 'librsdwapi.so' | head -n 1)
    fi
    if [ -z "${so}" ] || [ "$(head -c 4 "${so}" | od -An -c | tr -d ' ')" != '177ELF' ]; then
        echo "[install] WARNING: download is not a Linux shared library, skipping"
        return 0
    fi

    install -m 0755 "${so}" "${SERVER_DIR}/librsdwapi.so"
    mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/rsdwapi"
    echo "[install] RSDWServerAPI installed ($(stat -c %s "${SERVER_DIR}/librsdwapi.so") bytes)"
}

write_launcher() {
    cat > "${SERVER_DIR}/start.sh" <<'__START_SH__'
#!/bin/bash
# RuneScape: Dragonwilds + RSDWServerAPI - per-boot launcher for the Pterodactyl/Pelican egg.
# The egg's install script writes this file; reinstalling regenerates it. Every setting
# comes from the panel's startup variables, which Wings exports as environment variables.

cd /home/container || exit 1

GAME_BIN=./RSDragonwilds/Binaries/Linux/RSDragonwildsServer-Linux-Shipping
INI_DIR=RSDragonwilds/Saved/Config/LinuxServer
INI="${INI_DIR}/DedicatedServer.ini"
SECTION='[/Script/Dominion.DedicatedServerSettings]'

if [ ! -x "${GAME_BIN}" ]; then
    echo "[egg] ${GAME_BIN} is missing - reinstall the server (Settings > Reinstall)."
    exit 1
fi

# --- DedicatedServer.ini -------------------------------------------------------------
# Written on every boot: the game rewrites this file when it shuts down and strips
# AdminPassword from it at start, so panel values have to be re-applied each time.
# Other keys (ServerGuid in particular, generated on first run) are left untouched.
mkdir -p "${INI_DIR}"
[ -f "${INI}" ] || printf '%s\n' "${SECTION}" > "${INI}"
grep -qxF "${SECTION}" "${INI}" || printf '\n%s\n' "${SECTION}" >> "${INI}"

# set_key KEY VALUE - replace KEY inside SECTION, or add it to the end of SECTION.
# Values go through ENVIRON, not awk -v, so backslashes in passwords survive intact.
set_key() {
    # Blank lines inside the section are held back so a new key is added after the last
    # real line of the section, not after the gap before the next section header.
    INI_KEY="$1" INI_VAL="$2" INI_SEC="${SECTION}" awk '
        function flush() {
            if (insec && !done) { print ENVIRON["INI_KEY"] "=" ENVIRON["INI_VAL"]; done = 1 }
            for (; blanks > 0; blanks--) print ""
        }
        /^\[/ { flush(); insec = ($0 == ENVIRON["INI_SEC"]); print; next }
        insec && /^[ \t]*$/ { blanks++; next }
        { for (; blanks > 0; blanks--) print "" }
        insec && index($0, ENVIRON["INI_KEY"] "=") == 1 {
            if (!done) { print ENVIRON["INI_KEY"] "=" ENVIRON["INI_VAL"]; done = 1 }
            next
        }
        { print }
        END { flush() }
    ' "${INI}" > "${INI}.tmp" && mv "${INI}.tmp" "${INI}"
}

set_key ServerName       "${SERVER_NAME:-Dragonwilds Server}"
set_key DefaultWorldName "${DEFAULT_WORLD_NAME:-World}"
set_key OwnerId          "${OWNER_ID:-}"
set_key WorldPassword    "${WORLD_PASSWORD:-}"
set_key AdminPassword    "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}"

if [ -z "${OWNER_ID:-}" ]; then
    echo "[egg] WARNING: Owner ID is empty. The server will not finish starting without it."
    echo "[egg]          In game: Settings > scroll to the bottom > Player ID."
fi
if [ -n "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ] && [ "${ADMIN_PASSWORD}" = "${WORLD_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
    echo "[egg] WARNING: Admin Password equals World Password - every player who can join"
    echo "[egg]          the world becomes an admin. Use two different values."
fi

# --- RSDWServerAPI -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Preloaded into the game binary only. The mod ignores every other process (bash, the
# stock .sh wrapper, crash reporters), so the export is safe. RSDWAPI_* variables from the
# panel override settings.ini on each boot; blank ones are ignored.
if [ "${RSDWAPI_ENABLED:-1}" = "1" ] || [ "${RSDWAPI_ENABLED:-}" = "true" ]; then
    if [ -f /home/container/librsdwapi.so ]; then
        export LD_PRELOAD=/home/container/librsdwapi.so
        export RSDWAPI_DIR=/home/container/rsdwapi
        echo "[egg] RSDWServerAPI enabled: REST on ${RSDWAPI_API_BIND:-0.0.0.0}:${RSDWAPI_API_PORT:-8080}," \
             "RCON $( [ "${RSDWAPI_RCON_ENABLED:-0}" = "1" ] || [ "${RSDWAPI_RCON_ENABLED:-}" = "true" ] \
                      && echo "on port ${RSDWAPI_RCON_PORT:-27020}" || echo "off")." \
             "Config and logs: rsdwapi/"
    else
        echo "[egg] RSDWServerAPI is enabled but librsdwapi.so is missing - reinstall, or upload"
        echo "[egg] the file to the server root. Starting without it."
    fi
fi

exec "${GAME_BIN}" -log -Port="${SERVER_PORT}" \
    "-ini:Game:[/Script/Engine.GameSession]:MaxPlayers=${MAX_PLAYERS:-6}"
__START_SH__
    chmod +x "${SERVER_DIR}/start.sh"
}

need_tools
install_game || { echo "[install] game install failed"; exit 1; }
install_rsdwapi
write_launcher
echo "[install] done"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the in-game server browser.

variables.name: Owner ID
variables.description: Your in-game Player ID (Settings menu, bottom of the list). Required - the server will not finish starting without it. The owner can grant admin and unban.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: Save name of the world to load or create.

variables.name: World Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave blank for an open server.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Entered in Pause > Settings > Server Management to become admin. Must differ from the World Password.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Dedicated servers support up to 6 players.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the game through SteamCMD on every start (1 = on, 0 = off). Client and server versions must match exactly or players cannot see the server.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: RuneScape: Dragonwilds Dedicated Server tool.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: Enabled
variables.description: Preload the RSDWServerAPI mod (REST API, RCON, chat admin commands, Discord relay).

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: GitHub Repository
variables.description: owner/repo to download librsdwapi.so from on install. Point this at your own fork to run a patched build.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: Release
variables.description: Release tag to install, or 'latest'. Applied on (re)install.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: Download URL
variables.description: Optional direct link to librsdwapi.so or a zip containing it. Overrides the repository and release above.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: REST Port
variables.description: TCP port for the REST API. Must be an allocation assigned to this server.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: REST Bind Address
variables.description: 0.0.0.0 to reach the API from outside the container (a bot or panel on another host); 127.0.0.1 to keep it inside.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: REST Bearer Token
variables.description: Leave blank to keep the token generated on first start (see rsdwapi/settings.ini). Set it here to manage it from the panel.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: REST IP Whitelist
variables.description: Comma separated addresses or CIDR blocks allowed to connect. Blank allows everyone.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: RCON Enabled
variables.description: Source RCON listener (works with mcrcon, rcon-cli and panel RCON consoles).

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: RCON Port
variables.description: TCP port for RCON. Must be an allocation assigned to this server.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: RCON Password
variables.description: Leave blank to keep the password generated on first start.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: Discord Relay
variables.description: Post in-game chat and player deaths to Discord webhooks.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: Discord Chat Webhook
variables.description: Webhook URL for in-game chat.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI: Discord Death Webhook
variables.description: Webhook URL for deaths. Blank sends deaths to the chat webhook.
